in_hebrew.name: Doria
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dew, gift of the sea
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Doria הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Doria was the name of a nymph who personified the dew. She was a gentle and nurturing spirit, providing sustenance to the earth through her tears. In the Bible, Dorah is a variant of Dorcas, which means 'gazelle,' and is known for her acts of kindness and charity.
